definitions.explanation: The concept of absolute nothingness or nonexistence. An important concept in Buddhist philosophy and Zen, representing the absence of all things.
As a prefix, negates or indicates the absence of what follows. Extremely productive — attaches to many nouns to form compound words.

examples.japanese: {無|む}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{境地|きょうち}→境地：12121_kyouchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}する→達する：02129_tassuru⟧。
examples.english: To reach a state of nothingness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{禅|ぜん}→禅：03757_zen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無|む}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{悟|さと}る→悟る：12601_satoru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In Zen, it is considered important to realize nothingness.

examples.japanese: {有|う}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{無|む}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生|う}まれない→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{入場|にゅうじょう}→入場：03521_nyuujou⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無添加|むてんか}→無添加：19283_mutenka⟧です。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無関心|むかんしん}→無関心：13424_mukanshin⟧な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とった。

notes:
USAGE:
As a standalone word, {無|む} is philosophical and literary, closely tied to Buddhist and Zen thought. As a prefix, it is one of the most productive negation prefixes in Japanese, appearing in countless compounds.

COMMON COMPOUNDS (PREFIX):
- ⟦{無料|むりょう}→無料：01662_muryou⟧: free of charge
- ⟦{無理|むり}→無理：01558_muri⟧: impossible, unreasonable
- ⟦{無関心|むかんしん}→無関心：13424_mukanshin⟧: indifference
- ⟦{無添加|むてんか}→無添加：19283_mutenka⟧: additive-free
- ⟦{無意味|むいみ}→無意味：15527_muimi⟧: meaningless
- ⟦{無視|むし}→無視：13473_mushi⟧: ignoring, disregard
- ⟦{無限|むげん}→無限：00296_mugen⟧: infinite

SIMILAR WORDS:
Contrasts with {有|う}/{有|ゆう} (existence, having). Also compare with ⟦{非|ひ}→非：28419_hi⟧～ (non-, un-) and {不|ふ}～ (un-, dis-), which are similar negation prefixes with slightly different nuances.
